name: Derived maintenance renewal crossed with partner AND COLA AND non-USD simultaneously (four-factor stack)
what_it_tests: A single renewal maintenance line that is derived, partner-discounted, COLA-uplifted, AND non-USD must apply each factor exactly once in the correct order (prior-net base × COLA × partner-once × FX) without the J-05 oscillation/double-discount or G-02 currency-blind lookup; the maximal interaction cell is uncovered
proc_mechanism: DerivedProductsRenewals committer + COLA Uplift Net on Renewal + PartnerNetPricePosthook v1.5 (skip deferred path when COLA-owned) + Currency Conversion Net Unit Price; PartnerNetPricePosthook must not re-discount already-netted COLA base; FX must apply to the final net once
expected_behavior: Net = priorAssetNet × (1+COLA%) × (1−partner% if not already in base) × currencyMult, applied once each; stable across multiple reprices; no oscillation, no double-discount, no USD-value leak
test_setup: Renewal RRM maintenance line, ItemIsDerived=true, Deal_Type='Channel Originated' 12% prior-netted, COLA 7.85%, EUR (0.9346), reprice 3× and compare

prior_run.actual: Maint line PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK (EUR) repriced to NetUnitPrice=0, NetTotalPrice=0, UnitPrice=0, ListPrice=0 across 3 Force reprices (stable, no oscillation). Seed Base_Price__c=3400/Pre_Partner=3400/COLA=7.85/Partner=12 ignored. Same SKU prices to 71 net in USD. License line NetTotal=15888.2 OK.
prior_run.evidence: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FZN70AO/view (Quote#00781510); maint QLI 0QLWC000003kinW4AQ; USD-derived comparator QLI 0QLWC000003kiZ04AI net=71
prior_run.defectStep: Derived Products - Renewals (V21 step 43) / COLA Uplift Net on Renewal (step 26) / Derived Maintenance Net Filter (step 37)

Root cause = derived path currency-gated: only USD Fortra PBE 01uWC000005wsbUYAQ has IsDerived=true; EUR PBE 01uWC000005wzX8YAI used by line has IsDerived=false, so ItemIsDerived__std=false and steps 26/37/43 never engage.
